cityEdition: El Viejo San Juan: EUC Thrills by VibezZzCoder — https://github.com/VibezZzCoder/euc-sanjuan
note: Vehicle-model, traffic, pedestrian and city-sound code adapted from the New York and San Francisco editions of EUC Thrills (MIT: Mr.doob, Kamil, VibezZzCoder). Each entry records a San Juan file, a donor source file and its pre-adaptation bytes and hash, and the San Juan file's hash. The listed public release has identical bytes for the recorded donor files.

files.derived: Body index, vehicle crash slices and posed vehicle body as ES exports; the pedestrian reaction helpers of the donor file are not included here.

Car loft geometry, wheels, mirrors, rails, bed cover, stand-in and the lofted car and wheel TSL materials; bus, taxi sign, light bar, plate atlas and New York liveries removed; San Juan body types, liveries, rear-only illegible plate, accessories and hour-driven lamps added.
The body sections used for parked-car solids bin the drawn triangles along the car as the San Francisco edition cuts its crash slices; output, step and merge rules are San Juan's.

Car following (Intelligent Driver Model braking and free acceleration), the stop-sign sequence (full stop, order of arrival, timeout only with a clear junction), grade slowing with the uphill crawl, and the steering, signal and body-pitch pose; the lane graph, junction claims, manners towards people and the rider, and the population are new.

The skinned crowd figure (lofted body and its level-of-detail geometry, 15-bone skeleton, vertex-stage skinning from pose storage, instanced near/far batches, planted-foot gait with two-bone IK) as an ES module; San Juan wardrobe material (per-person colours and garment styles instead of seed-hashed winter palettes), worn items (cap, hat, day-pack, shoulder bag, skirt), seated, photograph and talking poses, explicit boot warm-up; the bicycle pose is not included.

The pedestrian reactions to the rider (anticipating sidestep, admitted-impact shove with pause and return, cooldown) and the meeting scheduler, rewritten around San Juan's walk network; population, routes, places, seats, crossings and groups are new.

Footstep (heel, roll, scuff, grit fragments), formant pseudo-speech (glottal pulse, jitter and shimmer, three moving resonators, consonant onsets) and the two-reed horn as plain sample generators; re-voiced softer and warmer (grit band lowered, horn harmonics reduced and low-passed), plus new surprised outbursts; crash, debris, signal and wind voices not included.

The four-stroke exhaust loop (twenty whole cycles, per-cylinder strength and timing, release pulse with body resonance) and the warmed noise loop, without valve clatter or the high-rev bank; the sett rumble, the plaza murmur and the job list are new; motor voice graph, gears and siren not included.

Voice caps (8/6 motors, 8/5 events) with retiring voices counted against the cap, the 22 m step, 30 m talk and air low-pass distance rules, alternating conversation turns and the outburst on a rising bumped counter, rewritten as allocation-free decisions without audio objects; matching cars by position, the keep bonus, scheduled footsteps, the gear model for crawling cars and the murmur and distant-traffic bed levels are new.
